steps.name: boot-splash-gone
steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1')

steps.name: phase-checking
steps.eval: window.__uid = window.__store.getState().notify.start({ title: 'Checking for updates…', kind: 'progress' }); window.__store.getState().notify.update(window.__uid, { progress: null })

steps.name: phase-update-available
steps.eval: window.__store.getState().notify.dismiss(window.__uid); window.__store.getState().notify.start({ title: 'Update available', message: 'A new version of Sofa So Good is ready.', kind: 'info', icon: 'Versions', autoDismissMs: null, actionLabel: 'Update', onAction: () => {} })

steps.name: phase-uptodate
steps.eval: window.__store.getState().notify.start({ title: 'You’re on the latest version (v0.9.0.0)', kind: 'info' })
